rv.q: This “Company,” born in a now-departing moment when anti-emotionalist deconstructions of old musicals were all the rage, feels more like an experiment of interest that just did not fully work.
However, this version does not fully convey the underlying human emotions expressed in the songs.

cn.t: Critics give mixed reviews to this revival of Sondheim's classic, praising its exploration of love and human connection but questioning whether Elliott's updated vision fully succeeds for contemporary audiences.

vr.q: If this tour is coming anywhere near you, go see it.
